nodes.name: Every 5 seconds
nodes.notes: TESTING MODE. A full pass takes minutes; overlapping ticks are dropped by the lock in scraper.py.

nodes.name: Called By Supervisor
nodes.notes: Entry point used by 'screener-mcp :: supervisor' once the MCP server reports healthy.

parameters.command:
set -e
DIR=/home/node/.n8n/cron_scrapper
REPO=https://github.com/Tengenisu/cron_scrapper.git
TARBALL=https://codeload.github.com/Tengenisu/cron_scrapper/tar.gz/refs/heads/main

# --- fetch or update the repo (git if present, tarball fallback) ---
if [ -d "$DIR/.git" ]; then
  git -C "$DIR" pull --ff-only || true
elif command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  git clone --depth 1 "$REPO" "$DIR"
else
  echo 'git not found in container, falling back to tarball'
  mkdir -p "$DIR"
  wget -qO- "$TARBALL" | tar xz --strip-components=1 -C "$DIR"
fi

test -f "$DIR/scraper.py" || { echo 'SYNC_FAILED: scraper.py missing'; exit 1; }

# --- the n8n image ships node but NOT python: say so here, loudly ---
# scraper.py is stdlib-only, so any python3 >= 3.9 will do.
PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python || true)"
if [ -z "$PY" ]; then
  echo 'SYNC_WARN: no python interpreter in this container -- Run Scraper cannot work.'
  echo '  fix with:  docker exec -u root <n8n-container> apk add --no-cache python3'
  echo '  or bake python3 into a custom n8n image, or run scraper.py on the host.'
else
  echo "python=$("$PY" -V 2>&1) at $PY"
fi

echo "SYNC_OK dir=$DIR node=$(node -v)"

nodes.name: Sync Scraper Repo
nodes.notes: Idempotent clone/pull, mirroring the supervisor's build step. Also checks for a python interpreter -- the n8n image ships node but not python3.

parameters.command:
DIR=/home/node/.n8n/cron_scrapper
cd "$DIR"

# The n8n image has no python by default. Fail as one parseable JSON document
# rather than as an empty stdout the parser cannot explain.
PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python || true)"
if [ -z "$PY" ]; then
  echo '{"ok":false,"error":"no python interpreter in the n8n container -- see the Sync Scraper Repo output"}'
  exit 0
fi

# TESTING MODE: caching is off, so every run re-resolves symbols and re-queries
# the MCP server. A tick that overlaps a run in flight exits with skipped:true.
CACHE_ENABLED=0 \
MCP_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:3123/mcp \
LOG_LEVEL=INFO \
"$PY" scraper.py

nodes.name: Run Scraper
nodes.notes: scraper.py always prints one JSON document on stdout, including on failure and when python is missing.

nodes.name: Skipped Or Failed
nodes.notes: A skipped tick is normal at a 5-second cadence: the previous pass is still running.
